name: pixelpath
description: Turn voxel models into clear, step-by-step physical build plans.
author: Kaiwen Corp

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && npm run icon:generate && electron .
scripts.electron:check: node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/backend.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/updater.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run icon:generate && npm run backend:package && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build && npm run icon:generate && npm run backend:package && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src electron scripts README.md docs .github package.json
scripts.test: npm run electron:check && npm run build && python backend/test_geometry.py && python backend/test_app.py
